briefs.rationale: Rewrote the counting brief: it keeps the sum-rule, product-rule, factorial, binomial, inclusion-exclusion and pigeonhole development, and adds the finite-abelian-character interface with additive characters into the nonzero complex numbers, the dictionary with one-dimensional complex representations, and the normalized orthogonality relations, all choice-free.

Rewrote the probability brief: it keeps the density-witness, module, blockade, pure-pair, comb, restriction and sparsification development and the quantitative induced-density log-log bounds, and closes the E-graph and Bird deductions through pendant-leaf reductions to P5 and the bull, generalized niceness, and the resulting Erdos--Hajnal property with unspecified exponents.

Rewrote the ordinals-and-cardinals brief: it keeps the ordinal, large-cardinal, forcing and choice-strength spine and integrates the Easton page, covering the regular-continuum-function constraints, Easton class forcing realizing monotone continuum values at infinite regular cardinals under the cofinality constraint with singular cardinals excluded, and the characteristic numbers assembling the Cichon diagram.
